candidates.phrase: the faithful love that unites God and his people
candidates.rationale: Describes God's love toward his people as faithful, asserting a narrower covenantal faithfulness of God within the floor.
candidates.chunk_text: What is marriage? Marriage is the exclusive, lifelong, cove nantal union of love between one man and one woman, and a reflection of the faithful love that unites God and his people. Marriage is therefore holy and should the ten commandments “be held in honor among all.” (Hebrews 13:4; see also Genesis 2:18–24; Matthew 19:4–6; Ephesians 5:21–33; see questions 146–48)
